title: Privacy matrix: customer-selectable residency & retention bundles with subprocessor attestation flow
creator: Marco Hernandez
description: Background: Enterprise prospects frequently ask for a menu of data residency and retention options for contract negotiations. Current packaging is binary (standard vs. residency add-on) and forces lengthy legal redlines for subprocessors and retention terms. Goal: Prototype a 'privacy matrix' product that bundles selectable residency regions, retention windows, and an attestation workflow for subprocessors to reduce legal cycle time and enable tiered pricing. Success metrics: reduction in average contract negotiation time by 20%, increase in deal close rate for customers requiring EU/UK residency by 15%, and measurable uplift in ARPU for customers selecting higher-tier bundles. Out of scope: on-prem installation bundling and custom HSM integrations for this experiment. Requirements: (1) a clear mapping of residency options to pricing deltas, (2) standardized retention tiers with UI selection in the quote flow, (3) automated subprocessor attestation checklist and templated clause insertion for SOW/Order Form, (4) fallback SCC activation guidance for EU/UK deals. Constraints: legal must approve templated language; engineering capacity limited in Cycle 2025-W08; billing integration required for prorated upgrades. Approach: design two packaging prototypes (Simple and Granular) and run a two-week sales pilot with 6 enterprise prospects. Capture negotiation timelines and legal effort. Deliver a confluence PRD, a draft clause library for Legal, and a minimum viable UI in the console for quote entry. Acceptance criteria: (a) legal signs off on templated clauses, (b) sales pilot completes with at least 3 prospects selecting a bundle, (c) engineering provides a plan and estimate for an MVP implementation and billing hooks.
